runtime: Eclipse Adoptium OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM 27.0.1.0.2+1, GC G1, -Xmx2g -XX:+UseG1GC --add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector, one JVM per parser, Quartz 2.2.0

results.notes: Quartz's default JVM path: JacksonMapper.fromJson(String) -> Quartz EventDeserializer -> EventFactory builds the kind's Event subclass. Amethyst's production path until it switched to Kite (quartz-kite). Quartz 1.19.0 and earlier also interned id, pubkey and tag values here. gc_count/gc_ms: separate untimed pass after measurement, as many rounds as were measured, tight loop over preloaded Strings (no frames built), GarbageCollectorMXBean deltas.
results.objects_note: allocs_per_event: bytecode-level count (java-allocation-instrumenter 3.3.5 agent, separate untimed JVM, parse thread only, fewest of 3 passes after 3 warm-up passes; Strings counted in String's constructors), before JIT escape analysis, so it can be higher than what the JIT actually allocates. retained_objects_per_event: live instances added, from GC.class_histogram before/after keeping every result.
